literal_meaning: মুখ ফুলিয়ে তোলা (face swelling or puffing up)
figurative_meaning_en: to pout or make a sullen face
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাচ্চাটা খেলনা না পেয়ে মুখ ফোলালো।
সে প্রস্তাবে রাজি না হয়ে মুখ ফুলিয়ে বসল।
example_sentences_in_english: The child pouted when he didn't get the toy.
She sulked and made a sullen face when she wasn't agreed to the proposal.
note: This idiom vividly describes a child's or person's expression of mild anger or disappointment through facial puffing, common in Bengali expressive language.
